title: WeightCode: Installing New Capabilities into Neural Networks via Weight-Space Programming
abstract: arXiv:2611.25476v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural networks encode learned capabilities in their weights, yet extending those capabilities with explicit task knowledge remains a fundamental challenge. Here we show that Weight-Space Programming (WSP), in which executable programs read, construct or modify a network's weights directly, can install new capabilities within trained neural networks. WeightCode, a WSP framework, uses a frozen language model to write executable weight programs that install new computations into trained neural networks using task knowledge and their existing weights, without gradient-based training. Once installed, the new capabilities run independently of the language model. Given a grammar or eight demonstrations, weight programs enable previously unseen command compositions (0% to 99.8% exact match) and a new pickup action (0% to 98.4% success), while preserving the original command and navigation capabilities. translated_title: WeightCode：通过权重空间编程为神经网络安装新能力
translated_abstract: 神经网络将其学习到的能力编码在权重之中，然而如何借助显式任务知识来扩展这些能力仍然是一个根本性的挑战。本研究展示了权重空间编程（WSP）——即由可执行程序直接读取、构建或修改网络权重——能够在已训练的神经网络中安装新能力。WeightCode是一个WSP框架，它使用冻结的语言模型来编写可执行的权重程序，利用任务知识和网络的现有权重，将新的计算安装到已训练的神经网络中，而无需基于梯度的训练。一旦安装完成，新能力便可独立于语言模型运行。在给定一个语法或八个演示样本的情况下，权重程序使网络能够执行之前未见过的命令组合（精确匹配率从0%提升至99.8%）和新的拾取动作（成功率从0%提升至98.4%），同时保留原有的命令执行与导航能力。在ImageNet数据集上，四个权重程序实现了……
tldr: 提出WeightCode框架，利用冻结语言模型编写可执行的权重程序，无需梯度训练即可直接修改神经网络权重以安装新能力，同时保留原有功能。
en_tdlr: WeightCode employs a frozen language model to write executable weight programs that directly modify network weights, installing new capabilities into trained neural networks without gradient-based training while preserving existing functionality.
